Gravel Happy Hour

Olympia, WA · Gravel

Beginner friendly

Gravel Happy Hour is a gravel group ride in Olympia, WA. Schedule: Second and fourth Sundays, October through March; meeting spot and time announced with each route, from Capitol State Forest (trailhead varies). Pace: two groups: a beginner ride and a faster ride.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the start time. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: two groups: a beginner ride and a faster ride. It splits into pace groups. Pick the slowest one your first time; you can move up next week.
Check
Look at @racecascadia the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Gravel Happy Hour group ride

Off-season gravel rides in Capitol Forest, two a month. One is a beginner ride led by the Olympia Mountain Bike Ride Club. The other is faster and led by Big Stump Bikes. Routes and meeting spots are posted before each ride.
